"""Three authored offline controls. Passing tests characterize current behavior;
they do not approve semantic fidelity, repair model samples, or execute CAP.
The negative-reference control checks the memory boundary directly after a
faithful committed turn; the model cannot supply canonical source event IDs.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from api.context_service import ContextQuery, assemble_context
from api.llm.contract import CancellationToken
from api.llm.testing import FakeLLMAdapter
from api.memory_service import validate_memory_candidate
from api.orchestrator_service import _context_prompt, _stored_memory_context_item
from api.persistence import SQLitePersistence
from api.scene_director_service import SceneContinuationProposal
from api.scene_service import scene_fact_text, scene_from_context
from api.state_service import sync_event_from_context
from api.turn_execution_service import execute_prepared_turn
from api.turn_models import CanonicalEvent, CanonicalFact, MemoryCandidate

REPO = Path(r"C:\Users\skate\.codex\worktrees\b008\AgenteStoryteller")
PROOF = Path(__file__).parent
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "authored_boundary_existing_fixture_helpers",
    REPO / "tests" / "test_turn_execution_service.py",
)
assert _spec is not None and _spec.loader is not None
_helpers = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(_helpers)

NARRATIVE = (
    "A porta cede e revela a sala vazia. Uma luminária de base azul ilumina "
    "o mapa dobrado sobre a mesa. Um estojo fechado repousa junto ao mapa; "
    "duas poltronas estão afastadas da estante."
)
FAITHFUL = "Uma luminária de base azul ilumina o mapa dobrado na sala vazia."
TRANSFERRED = "Uma luminária emite luz azul sobre o mapa dobrado na sala vazia."


def authored_proposal(summary: str) -> SceneContinuationProposal:
    return SceneContinuationProposal.model_validate({
        "narrative": NARRATIVE,
        "outcome": "success",
        "location": "Sala vazia",
        "scene_summary": summary,
        "npcs_present": [],
        "new_facts": [{
            "kind": "observation",
            "summary": "Um estojo fechado repousa junto ao mapa.",
            "visibility": "player",
            "importance": 0.5,
            "pending": False,
        }],
        "open_threads": [],
        "resolved_threads": [],
        "player_prompt": "O que você faz agora?",
    })


def record_evidence(name: str, value: dict) -> None:
    (PROOF / f"{name}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )


async def completed_authored_turn(tmp_path: Path, summary: str, operation: str):
    prepared = _helpers._prepared(operation)
    store = SQLitePersistence(tmp_path / "authored.sqlite3")
    initial = sync_event_from_context("session", prepared.updated_context)
    await store.ensure_campaign("session", initial_state=initial.model_dump(mode="json"))
    target, capabilities = _helpers._target_and_capabilities()
    proposal = authored_proposal(summary)
    gateway = FakeLLMAdapter(
        capability_set=capabilities, structured_payload=proposal.model_dump(mode="json")
    )
    delivered = []

    async def collect(value):
        delivered.append(value)

    result = await execute_prepared_turn(
        prepared,
        session_id="session",
        operation_id=operation,
        user_input=prepared.draft.player_input,
        chronicle_name="Authored offline boundary controls",
        store=store,
        gateway=gateway,
        target=target,
        cancellation=CancellationToken(),
        on_chunk=collect,
    )
    assert result.status == "completed", result.error
    assert result.narrative is not None
    assert delivered == [proposal.player_text]
    assert result.narrative.text == proposal.player_text
    assert gateway.external_call_count == 1  # FakeLLMAdapter counter, zero network.
    turns = await store.list_turns("session")
    events = await store.list_events("session")
    candidates = await store.list_memory_candidates("session")
    memories = await store.list_episodic_memories("session")
    assert len(turns) == len(candidates) == len(memories) == 1
    event = next(item for item in events if item["event_type"] == "scene_established")
    assert event["summary"] == candidates[0]["summary"] == memories[0]["summary"] == summary
    assert candidates[0]["validation_status"] == "accepted"
    assert candidates[0]["source_event_ids"] == [event["event_id"]]
    scene = scene_from_context(prepared.updated_context)
    assert scene is not None and scene.summary == summary
    assert summary in scene_fact_text(scene)

    restored = await store.retrieve_memories(
        "session", query="luminária mapa", allowed_visibilities=("public", "player"),
        token_budget=2000,
    )
    assert len(restored) == 1
    context_item = _stored_memory_context_item(restored[0])
    assert context_item is not None
    packet = assemble_context(
        [context_item], ContextQuery(query_text="luminária mapa", token_budget=2000)
    )
    assert len(packet.selected) == 1
    context_text = _context_prompt(packet)
    assert summary in context_text
    return {
        "proposal": proposal, "store": store, "result": result,
        "turns": turns, "events": events, "candidates": candidates,
        "memories": memories, "context_text": context_text,
    }


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_authored_faithful_summary_survives_the_real_local_chain(tmp_path):
    data = await completed_authored_turn(tmp_path, FAITHFUL, "faithful-authored")
    record_evidence("faithful", {
        "origin": "authored_control_not_model_sample", "provider_calls": 0,
        "narrative": NARRATIVE, "summary": FAITHFUL,
        "agent_semantic_classification": "faithful",
        "turn_status": data["result"].status,
        "candidate_status": data["candidates"][0]["validation_status"],
        "context_text": data["context_text"], "semantic_approval": None,
    })


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_authored_unknown_reference_is_rejected_at_memory_boundary(tmp_path):
    data = await completed_authored_turn(tmp_path, FAITHFUL, "invalid-ref-authored")
    candidate = MemoryCandidate.model_validate(data["candidates"][0]["payload"])
    forged_data = candidate.model_dump(mode="json")
    forged_data.update(
        source_event_ids=["authored-event-does-not-exist"],
        validation_status="pending", validation_notes=[],
    )
    forged = MemoryCandidate.model_validate(forged_data)
    events = tuple(CanonicalEvent.model_validate(item["payload"]) for item in data["events"])
    facts = tuple(CanonicalFact.model_validate(item) for item in data["turns"][0]["facts"])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="references unknown event"):
        validate_memory_candidate(
            forged, events=events, narratives=(data["result"].narrative,), facts=facts,
            semantic_grounding_confirmed=True,
        )
    assert len(await data["store"].list_episodic_memories("session")) == 1
    record_evidence("invalid-reference", {
        "origin": "authored_control_not_model_sample", "provider_calls": 0,
        "scope": "direct_memory_validation_after_faithful_turn",
        "unknown_reference_rejected": True, "additional_memory_promoted": False,
        "semantic_approval": None,
    })


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_authored_color_transfer_survives_current_policy_despite_valid_references(tmp_path):
    faithful = authored_proposal(FAITHFUL).model_dump(mode="json")
    transferred = authored_proposal(TRANSFERRED).model_dump(mode="json")
    assert {key for key in faithful if faithful[key] != transferred[key]} == {"scene_summary"}
    assert "base azul" in NARRATIVE and "luz azul" not in NARRATIVE
    data = await completed_authored_turn(tmp_path, TRANSFERRED, "color-transfer-authored")
    record_evidence("color-transfer", {
        "origin": "authored_control_not_model_sample", "provider_calls": 0,
        "narrative": NARRATIVE, "summary": TRANSFERRED,
        "agent_semantic_classification": "unsupported_base_to_emission_transfer",
        "turn_status": data["result"].status,
        "candidate_status": data["candidates"][0]["validation_status"],
        "context_text": data["context_text"], "semantic_approval": None,
        "test_meaning": "characterizes_current_gap_does_not_approve_or_fix_it",
    })

conclusions: A transferência autorada base azul → luz azul foi aceita e reapareceu no contexto sob referências válidas. Não demonstra incidente de campanha nem desempenho de um modelo real.
A rejeição por referência inexistente e a preservação literal após commit funcionam no escopo testado.
O defeito estreito de origem no fallback vazio foi reproduzido e corrigido, sem trocar a política de admissão de cena.
A política atual não prova fidelidade geral, limite já reconhecido na especificação. Não foi encontrado outro defeito local demonstrado nesta auditoria que resolva esse problema geral.
A revisão de autoridade de registros é proposta de produto separada, não aprovação de runtime/CAP nem nova observação agendada.
